title: Statistical Inference for Adversarial Training: Central Limit Theorems via Optimal Transport
abstract: arXiv:2609.22240v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The purpose of this paper is to rigorously quantify the statistical and learning-theoretic properties of adversarial training models for classification. Equivalently, we establish the statistical properties of empirical optimal partial transport. Precisely, first we provide two types of central limit theorems (CLT): CLT centered at the expected empirical value, and CLT centered at the population one with smoothing. These results are based on the uniqueness of optimal potential for various equivalent optimal transport formulations, and the empirical process theory argument. For the binary setting, we indeed prove the uniqueness of optimal potential by leveraging the connection between optimal partial transport and the derived multi-marginal optimal transport formula. As byproducts, we also obtain the stability of a saddle point of the adversarial training model, and the sample complexity and concentration probability of the generalization

translated_title: 对抗训练的统计推断：基于最优传输的中心极限定理
translated_abstract: 本文旨在严格量化分类任务中对抗训练模型的统计性质与学习理论性质。等价地，我们建立了经验最优部分传输的统计性质。具体而言，我们首先提供了两类中心极限定理（CLT）：以期望经验值为中心的CLT，以及以带平滑的总体值为中心的CLT。这些结果基于多种等价最优传输形式中最优势的唯一性，以及经验过程理论的论证。在二分类情形下，我们通过利用最优部分传输与所推导的多边际最优传输公式之间的联系，确实证明了最优势的唯一性。作为副产品，我们还获得了对抗训练模型鞍点的稳定性，以及泛化的样本复杂度和集中概率。
tldr: 本文通过建立经验最优部分传输的两类中心极限定理，严格量化了分类对抗训练模型的统计性质，并借助最优势唯一性的证明，进一步得到了对抗训练模型鞍点的稳定性与泛化的样本复杂度等结果。
en_tdlr: This paper rigorously quantifies the statistical properties of adversarial training for classification by establishing two types of central limit theorems for empirical optimal partial transport, proving the uniqueness of optimal potentials, and deriving saddle point stability and generalization sample complexity as byproducts.
